integrity_guards_note: DERIVED from the selection's own sources by integrity_guards(), not hand-listed -- the hand list was wrong on its first run. Nothing is deselected; these are the node ids a failure is classified AGAINST.

mutants.breaks: Opens the horizontal-speed gate at every speed. The gate exists because the heading/course relation contributes nothing below a speed threshold; removing it feeds noise into a relation as though it were evidence.
Closes the same gate permanently. The mirror of GATING-01: a gate stuck shut removes a relation entirely, which the layer must report as unassessable rather than as healthy.
Arms every propulsion relation from tick zero, before the vehicle is armed. Pre-arm ESC and current readings are not evidence about flight.
Declares GPS valid at every tick, including during injected fix loss. This is the closest single-line analogue of the systems paper's headline mechanism, and it must not survive.
Raises the likelihood floor tenfold. EPS is departure 1 of 4 from a Bayes posterior and is why the output is a normalized hypothesis weight.
Removes evidence tempering entirely. Departure 3 of 4.
Inverts the EWMA constant, turning ~15 ticks of smoothing into almost none. Departure 2 of 4, and the systems paper's latency figures rest on the resulting time constant.
Zeroes the physical-consistency weight, so cross-sensor relations stop contributing to any trust coefficient.
Multiplies the Beta prior mass by 100. S_0 = 475.6775 -- the measured settled mass in the 118.82 chain -- is a consequence of this prior.
Makes nothing ever go stale, so a dead sensor's last value is treated as current evidence indefinitely.

mutants.breaks: Removes the escalation dwell, so a single tick flaps the failsafe level. The 1.0 s dwell is the term CUSUM_FAIRNESS.yaml removes before any latency comparison -- red team 2.3.
Removes the baseline detectors' dwell. The Mechanism-B comparison is against these baselines; a baseline that fires instantly is not the baseline the paper describes.
Caps every hypothesis at one source, so no multi-source hypothesis can form and shared-cause attribution becomes impossible.

Makes the UNKNOWN hypothesis unreachable, so unexplained evidence is always attributed to a modeled cause. This is precisely the failure the DEA profile forbids: attribution without separating evidence.
Promotes every hypothesis to ACTIVE regardless of accumulated evidence.
Lets a single degraded source establish a shared-resource verdict, removing the multi-source requirement the baselines are built on.
Drops the navigation caution threshold to zero, so no trust value ever crosses it. T* = 0.75 is in the 118.82 chain and in every latency figure compared against CUSUM.
Makes IMU isolation unreachable, so a divergent dual-IMU pair is never resolved to one unit.
Collapses the forgetting factor's lower bound, so the engine discards history almost immediately under disagreement.
Collapses the temporal-coherence window, so simultaneity carries no weight in shared-cause assessment.
Flattens the causal scoring curve, so every candidate cause scores alike and ranking becomes arbitrary.
Declares every source degraded, so shared-cause assessment always has a full membership set to reason over.
Removes the voting baseline's threshold, so it detects at every tick.

self_check.why: The canary sets PRIOR_NOMINAL to zero. If it had survived, every result here would be a false survivor caused by the editable install resolving `import csia` to the unmutated repository.

verdict_vocabulary.EQUIVALENT: author judgement, recorded in MUTATION_PLAN.md and never inferred by this script
verdict_vocabulary.INVALID_MUTANT: the mutated program does not run -- collection error or a pytest usage exit. Says nothing about the test suite.
verdict_vocabulary.KILLED: at least one failing test was not a source-integrity guard, so a BEHAVIOUR change was detected
verdict_vocabulary.KILLED_BY_INTEGRITY_ONLY: every failing test was a source-integrity guard -- a file-hash or tag diff, which would fire identically on a reformatted comment. The change cannot reach a commit, and NO test asserts the behaviour this line produces. Treated as a survivor for the purpose of 'what do the tests establish about the science'.
